source: 608 The Way to Find Prey
target: 608 Via ad Praedam Inveniendam

source: The rhythmic thumping echoed only three times before escalating into a resounding bang.
target: Ictus rhythmi tantum ter resonaverunt, antequam in ingentem fragorem evolverunt.

source: As the sturdy wooden door flung open, the corridor bathed in the glow of kerosene wall lamps revealed a darkness entwined with overgrown weeds.
target: Cum robusta porta lignea abrupte aperta esset, et corridor in luce lampadarum kerosinae effuso illustratus esset, tenebras detexit, intricatas cum exuberantia herbarum.

source: Crimson flames surged forth, casting an eerie illumination.
target: Flammae coccineae irruerunt, lumen terribilem diffundentes.

source: In Lugano’s gaze, the illusion of the oak tree abruptly dissipated, along with Father Montserrat, cradling an unseen infant in his arms.
target: In conspectu Lugani, illusio quercus repentina evanuit, simulque cum Patre Montserrat, qui infantem invisum in brachiis tenebat.

source: Amidst the fiery chaos, the weeds withered, and the shadows dispersed.
target: In medio ignis tumulto, herbae marcescebant, et umbrae se disperserunt.

source: Lugano found himself “returned” to the humble prayer room, now aglow with the crimson moonlight.
target: Lugano se repperit "reditum" in humilem conclave precationis, nunc rubro lumine lunari fulgentem.

source: Lumian, sporting a golden straw hat, emerged at the entrance.
target: Lumian, gerens pileum aureum stramineum, ad ostium apparuit.

source: His eyes scanned every nook, yet Father Montserrat remained elusive.
target: Oculi eius omnem angulum perlustrebant, sed Pater Montserrat elusorius manebat.

source: Powers akin to the Paramita world merged with other traits, albeit incapable of creating a sufficiently independent world separate from reality.
target: Potentiae, affines mundo Paramitae, cum aliis indolis coalescebant, quamquam non sufficiebant ut mundum independentem a re creare possent.

source: It resembles Demon Warlock Burman gaining unique abilities through a forceful transition of pathways…
target: Hoc simile est Demon Mago Burman, qui per transitionem viarum fortis facultates singulares adipisci videtur…

source: Where is he hiding now?
target: Ubi nunc se abscondit?

source: Drawing from Ludwig’s knowledge from his food, Beyonders of the School of God’s Descent can conceal themselves in woodwork.
target: Ex scientia Luidwigiana ex cibo, Beyonders Scholae Dei Descensionis se in lignaria abscondere possunt.

source: Although I can’t confirm Father Montserrat’s corrupted affiliation with the School, the influence of the Great Mother is evident…
target: Quamquam non possum confirmare relationem corruptam Patris Montserrat cum Schola, influentia Magnae Matris manifesta est…

source: Lumian swiftly assessed the unfolding scenario.
target: Lumian celeriter casum evolutum aestimavit.

source: The lack of resistance from Father Montserrat, who refrained from fleeing or hiding, didn’t surprise Lumian.
target: Defectus oppositionis a Patre Montserrat, qui neque fugere neque se abscondere conatus est, Lumian non stupuit.

source: Performing the wave magic in the ship’s bar had been a casual display, not wanting to waste the temporary Governor of the Sea authority.
target: Exercitatio magiae fluctuum in taberna navis fuit ostentatio levibus, ne temporaria auctoritas gubernatoris maris periret.

source: However, the subsequent use of the colossal wave to “greet” Captain Pedro and Father Montserrat wasn’t mere showmanship.
target: Attamen, usus posterius fluctus ingentis ad salutandum Capitaneum Pedrum et Patrem Montserrat non erat mera ostentatio.

source: Unaware if the School of God’s Descent incident had concluded or if hidden Great Mother devotees lingered on the ship, Lumian deliberately showcased the might of a demigod Governor of the Sea to instill fear!
target: Nesciens utrum casus incidentia Scholae Dei Descensionis confectus esset aut num sectatores occulti Magnae Matris in nave mansissent, Lumian deliberato affectu potentiam semidei Gubernatoris Maris ostendit, ut timorem incuteret!

source: If there were no other Great Mother adherents or lurking threats, his “greeting” actions could be seen as showmanship.
target: Si nulli alii sectatores Magnae Matris aut latentia pericula adessent, eius "salutationis" actus ut ostentatio viderentur.

source: But if danger lurked, it would make the elusive elements cautious, forcing them to retreat deeper into hiding.
target: Sed si periculum latens esset, illa elementa elusiva cauta esse coegerent, atque eos ad altiora abscondendi impellere vellent.

source: Lumian planned to let the ship reach the next port, leaving the Church of Earth Mother authorities to deal with them.
target: Lumian constituit navem ad proximam portum pervenire, atque auctoritates Ecclesiae Matris Terrae ad eos operandum reliquit.

source: Father Montserrat, seemingly unwilling to face the adventurer Louis Berry head-on and his demigod prowess, opted for concealment, biding his time until the ship docked.
target: Pater Montserrat, videntur non volens adversari adventorem Ludovicum Berry et eius semideam potentiam, celationem elegit, tempus exspectans donec navis ad portum accesseret.

source: Had Lugano not luckily or unluckily stumbled upon the priest cradling the unseen infant, Father Montserrat might have continued portraying himself as a competent clergyman of the Church of Earth Mother, avoiding any confrontation with Louis Berry.
target: Si Lugano non casu fortuito aut infelici sacerdotem, infantem invisum complexum invenerit, Pater Montserrat fortasse se tamquam clericus idoneus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae ostenderet, ne ullam certationem cum Ludovico Berry haberet.

source: “F-Father Montserrat is a believer in the Great Mother! He was cradling an invisible baby!” Lugano hastily reported to Louis Berry, now realizing the gravity of the situation.
target: «P-Pater Montserrat credit in Magnam Matrem! Complectebatur infantem invisum!» Lugano festinanter Luico Berry nuntiavit, iam grave rei statum persentiens.

source: Cradling an invisible baby…
target: Complectens infantem invisum…

source: He could be hiding within the ship’s woodwork.
target: Potest se abscondere in operibus ligneis navis.

source: Lumian scanned the surroundings, inspecting chairs, the floor, and the Sacred Emblem of Life adorning the wooden wall.
target: Lumian circumiecta perlustrebat, inspectans sellas, pavimentum, et Sanctum Emblemata Vitae, quod pariete ligneo ornatum erat.

source: In an abrupt realization, he felt a stir in his heart as he approached the Sacred Emblem embodying Earth Mother.
target: In repente acquirente intellectione, motum in corde sensit, cum Sanctum Emblemata, quod Matrem Terrae incarnabat, accessisset.

source: Adorned with symbols of wheat, flowers, and spring water at the periphery, at its core lay a simple depiction of a baby.
target: Ornatum symbolis tritici, florum, et aquae fontis ad circumferentiam, in eius nucleo simplex imago infantis iacebat.

source: A baby!
target: Infans!

source: Advancing further, crimson flames radiated, setting the wooden floorboards and chairs ablaze.
target: Progrediens porro, flammae coccineae radiante luce, pavimenta lignea et sellas igni afflixerunt.

source: Coming to a halt before the Sacred Emblem of Life, Lumian extended his right hand, gently caressing the baby’s face.
target: Stans ante Sanctum Emblemata Vitae, Lumian dextram manum protulit, infantis faciem leniter tractans.

source: The wood instantly deteriorated, exuding a yellowish pus.
target: Ligna statim corruerunt, emittens pus luteus.

source: It seemed that the depiction of a baby surrounded by wheat and flowers had long decayed, shedding tears of blood.
target: Videbatur imago infantis, circumdata tritico et floribus, diu deperditam esse, lacrimas sanguinis effundens.

source: There’s a huge problem with the Church of Earth Mother…
target: Magnum problema in Ecclesia Matris Terrae existit…

source: Lumian narrowed his eyes.
target: Lumian oculos contraxit.

source: While unable to pinpoint the elusive Father Montserrat, he unearthed decay and darkness lurking beneath the veneer of the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Nondum possens detegere Patrem Montserrat elusivum, invenit tamen putredinem et tenebras latentes sub specie Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

source: Observing the charred remains of the woodwork and finding no trace of Father Montserrat, with more wooden hiding spots on the steel steam ship, Lumian turned and addressed Lugano, “Take me to the captain’s cabin.”
target: Observans reliquias in ligno combustas et nullum vestigium Patris Montserrat reperiens, cum plura loca abscondendi in navi ferrea vaporis esset, Lumian se vertit ad Lugano et dixit: “Duc me ad cubiculum capitani.”

source: “Alright.” Lugano visibly relaxed.
target: «Bene.» Lugano manifeste relaxatus est.

source: Exiting the prayer room, the crimson flames within swiftly extinguished, ceasing their advance.
target: Egressus ex conclave precationis, flammae coccineae intus celeriter exstinctae sunt, iter suum cessantes.

source: Inside the captain’s cabin, Pedro, spotting a handsome brown beard, grimaced as adventurer Louis Berry approached.
target: In cubiculo capitani, Pedro, barbam pulchram brunneam agnoscens, vultum contraxit, dum adventor Ludovicus Berry appropinquabat.

source: Experienced as he was, he knew that there might be trouble on the ship.
target: Cum peritus esset, intellexit fore ut in nave quaedam difficultas existeret.

source: During the School of God’s Descent incident, Adventurer Louis Berry had only dispatched a servant to explain matters.
target: Durante casu Scholae Dei Descensionis, Ludovicus Berry adventor solum servum misit ad res explicandas.

source: Now, here he was personally visiting!
target: Nunc hic ipse visitare venit!

source: What did this signify?
target: Quid hoc significabat?

source: It pointed to a more severe complication!
target: Hoc ad graviorem complicationem demonstrabat!

source: Without awaiting the captain’s inquiry, Lumian calmly asserted, “Father Montserrat has succumbed, aligning himself with an evil deity. He likely colluded with the School of God’s Descension’s evil warlock.”
target: Sine captanei quaestione exspectata, Lumian tranquille asserit: “Pater Montserrat cecidit, se cum deitate mala coniungens. Probabiliter cum mago malo Scholae Dei Descensionis coniunctus est.”

source: Captain Pedro’s mind jolted as if struck by a rod, momentarily buzzing and going blank.
target: Mens Capitani Pedri quasi baculo icta, momento vibrans atque vacua facta est.

source: After a brief pause, he cautiously inquired, “Have you already killed him?”
target: Post brevissimam pausam, caute interrogavit: “Iam eum occidistine?”

source: “Not yet,” Lumian truthfully responded.
target: «Nondum,» Lumian vere respondit.

source: “He escaped the prayer room and is now in hiding.
target: «E conclave precationis effugit et nunc se abscondit.»

source: Dispatch a telegram promptly, reporting this to the Church of Earth Mother and the Feynapotter government.
target: Mitte celeriter telegraphem, hoc referens Ecclesiae Matris Terrae et gubernationi Feynapotter.

source: My servant will provide the details.
target: Servus meus singula enarraret.

source: In the face of Louis Berry’s authoritative directive, Captain Pedro yielded without resistance.
target: Ob praeceptum auctoritatis Ludovici Berry, Capitaneus Pedro sine repugnatione cedit.

source: He shifted his attention to Lugano, absorbing the account of his conversion and Father Montserrat’s description, cradling an invisible infant.
target: Animadvertit ad Lugano, audiens narrationem conversionis suae atque descriptionem Patris Montserrat, qui infantem invisum complectebat.

source: Upon hearing the revelation, Pedro wore a bitter expression and admitted, “I did sense something amiss with Father Montserrat, but I never anticipated it to be this grave.”
target: Audita revelatione, Pedro vultum amarum habuit et confessus est: “Aliquid in Patre Montserrat male sentiebam, sed numquam id tam grave fore putavi.”

source: “What’s the issue?” Lumian inquired.
target: «Quid accidit?» inquit Lumian.

source: Pedro sighed, explaining, “He’s a Favored, a Beyonder of the Earth pathway, the most orthodox clergyman.
target: Pedro suspiravit, explicans: “Ille est ‘Favored’, Beyonder viae Terrae, clericus orthodoxus summus.”

source: Typically, he needs a Blessed’s help to conduct Mass, preach to believers, and guide others into the Church.
target: Plerumque auxilium “Blessed” requirit ad Missam celebrandam, fideles praedicandos, et alios in Ecclesiam ducendos.

source: However, he’s the only Favored on this ship without a Blessed.
target: Attamen, ille solus Favored in hac nave est sine “Blessed.”

source: “I initially thought the shortage of staff in Port Santa was due to the sea prayer ritual, so I didn’t pay much heed.
target: Primum putavi carentiam operariorum in Port Santa propter ritu precationis maritimae esse, ideo parum attendebam.

source: But now, with Father Montserrat’s fall…
target: Sed nunc, cum casus Patris Montserrat…

source: Only with the assistance of a Blessed can one conduct Mass and preach to believers.
target: Solum cum auxilio “Blessed” Missa celebrari et fideles praedicari possunt.

source: There’s no Blessed following him…
target: Nullus “Blessed” eum sequitur…

source: Lumian had previously learned that Favored of the Church of Earth Mother needs at least one second-in-command Blessed for their decisions to be considered valid.
target: Lumian antea didicerat Favored Ecclesiae Matris Terrae saltem unum “Blessed” subimperatorem requirere, ut eorum decisiones validae esse possent.

source: Otherwise, it risks being perceived as an influence of an evil god or a demon…
target: Alioquin, periculum est ut influxus dei mali aut daemonis videatur…

source: An evil god…
target: Deus malus…

source: That Great Mother?
target: Illa Magna Mater?

source: Wh… Combined with recent events and his prior knowledge, Lumian suddenly grasped why the Church of Earth Mother maintained two distinct systems—
target: Ha... Coniunctis recentibus eventibus atque priore cognitione, Lumian subito intellexit cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae duas rationes distinguendas servaret—

source: Blessed and Favored—rather than merging them.
target: “Blessed” et “Favored” — potiūs quam coniuncti.

source: Madam Magician of the Apprentice pathway had mentioned occasional influence from the Celestial Worthy, unsure if it was a revelation from Mr. Fool.
target: Domina Magica viae Apprendentium memoraverat interdum influxum ex “Celestial Worthy”, incerta utrum revelatio a Domine Stulto esset.

source: Similar to the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings overseeing the Apprentice, Seer, and Marauder pathways, the Great Mother likely stood atop the Planter, Apothecary, and Villain pathways.
target: Similiter ac “Celestial Worthy” Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus, qui vias Apprendentium, Videntes, et Marauder regit, Magna Mater verisimiliter constitit in summo loco viarum Plantatorum, Apothecariorum, et Malefactorum.

source: As a result, Favored Beyonders of the Planter and Apothecary pathways would also be under the influence of the Great Mother.
target: Ex his, Favored Beyonders viarum Plantatorum et Apothecariorum quoque sub influentia Magnae Matris erunt.

source: The origin of the revelation, whether from Earth Mother or the Great Mother, remained unclear.
target: Origo revelationis, sive ex Matre Terrae sive ex Magnae Matre, incerta erat.

source: Confirmation required the input of Blessed from pathways outside these two.
target: Confirmatio postulebat inputum “Blessed” ex viis extra his duabus.

source: Simultaneously, Blessed monitored the status of the Favored!
target: Simul, “Blessed” statum Favored observabat!

source: That explains it…
target: Id explanat…

source: Indeed, there’s a profound and serious reason behind this seemingly absurd, wasteful, and unreasonable system design, Lumian concluded.
target: Revera, Lumian conclusit esse causam profundam et gravem huius consilii systematis, quod apparenter absurdum, vastum, atque iniustum est.

source: Without further words, he instructed Captain Pedro, “Send the telegram.”
target: Sine ulterioribus verbis, praecepit Capitani Pedri: “Mitte telegraphem.”

source: After the captain relayed Father Montserrat’s situation to the Feynapotter government and the Church of Earth Mother, Lumian contemplated how to locate Father Montserrat.
target: Postquam capitaneus rem Patris Montserrat ad gubernationem Feynapotter et Ecclesiam Matris Terrae nuntiavit, Lumian cogitavit quomodo Patrem Montserrat invenire posset.

source: Considering the vast sea surrounding them, unless Father Montserrat possessed teleportation or exceptional underwater travel abilities, he could only be hiding somewhere on the ship.
target: Considerans immensum mare eos circumdantem, nisi Pater Montserrat facultatem teleportandi aut subaquaticam proficiscendi praestaret, solum in navi se abscondere posset.

source: Lumian dismissed the idea of involving his Major Arcana card holder for such a trivial issue and resolved to devise a solution himself.
target: Lumian ideam includendi tenentem chartarum Major Arcana in re tam levi reiecit et decrevit se solum ad solutionem excogitandam incumbere.

source: Could I use the ship’s megaphone to insult the Great Mother, provoking Father Montserrat to reveal himself?
target: Possumne megaphonum navis ad Magnam Matrem deridendam adhibere, atque sic Patrem Montserrat provocare, ut se ostenderet?

source: The challenge lies in the inability to lock onto a target, potentially yielding less-than-optimal results…
target: Difficultas latet in incapacitate in metam fixandi, quae fortasse effectus minus optimos praebeat…

source: Burning all the ship’s woodwork? Seems like a last resort due to the presence of valuable goods in wooden crates…
target: Incendendo totum opus ligneum navis? Videtur ultimum consilium esse, propter praesentiam bonorum pretiosorum in arca ligneae…

source: Borrowing a bottle of Prophetic Concoction from Franca?
target: Mutuare amphoram “Prophetic Concoction” a Franca?

source: It requires a fresh corpse.
target: Exigit corpus recens.

source: Additionally, if Franca is involved, I could get her to directly employ Magic Mirror Divination…
target: Praeterea, si Franca implicabitur, eam possim persuadere ut Divinationem Speculi Magici directe adhibeat…

source: Playing the Symphony of Hatred bone flute and informing passengers to cover their ears prior to that?
target: Canendo symphoniam odii in fistula ossium et admonendo vectores ut aures suas tegeant ante hoc?

source: But it only reduces damage without averting the effects…
target: Sed id solum damnum minuere potest, nec vero consequentias avertit…

source: Right, ask Ludwig if he recalls Father Montserrat’s small…
target: Recte, roga Luidwigi si meminerit parva de Patre Montserrat…

source: Also… Yes, I can give it a try!
target: Etiam… Sic, id conari possum!

source: Lumian quickly came up with several solutions and decided to systematically test each one, reserving seeking help as a final option.
target: Lumian celeriter plura consilia excogitavit et decrevit singula systematice tentare, auxilium petendum in extremum optionem reservans.

source: He bid farewell to the captain and, under the cover of night, led Lugano back to the first-class cabin suite.
target: Valedixit capitanei et, sub tegmine noctis, Lugano ad conclave primae classe duxit.

source: “Do you recall Father Montserrat’s scent?” Lumian inquired of Ludwig.
target: «Meministine odorem Patris Montserrat?» inquit Lumian Luidwigo.

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Luidwig caput quassavit.

source: “No direct contact.”
target: «Nullus directus commercium.»

source: “Fair enough.” Lumian turned around, offering a reassuring smile to Lugano.
target: «Satis est.» Lumian conversus est, et Lugano risum fiducialem obtulit.

source: “I have an experiment in mind. Work with me.”
target: «Experimentum habeo in mente. Mecum labora.»

source: “What kind of experiment?” Lugano asked, a tremor of fear evident.
target: «Quod genus experimenti?» inquit Lugano, timoris tremore evidente.

source: Lumian gestured towards the window.
target: Lumian ad fenestram digitum indicavit.

source: “Go to the deck. It’s more open there.”
target: «Vade ad pontem navis. Ibi apertius est.»

source: Uneasily, Lugano descended to the deck, bathed in the crimson moonlight.
target: Lugano, inquietus, ad pontem navis descendit, in luce lunari coccinea illustratus.

source: His employer pulled out a full-body silver armor from his Traveler’s Bag, revealing an inscrutable smile.
target: Dominus eius, ex sacco viatoris, loricam argenteam totam extraxit, risum insciti ostendens.

source: Lumian recalled the Pride Armor’s particular disdain for items from the Earth and Evernight pathways.
target: Lumian recordatus est fastidium singularem Loricae Superbiæ erga res ex viis Terrae et Evernight.

source: What if it wasn’t an item but a Beyonder?
target: Quid si non res esset, sed Beyonder?

source: How would it react?
target: Quomodo ageret?

source: Could this hatred be harnessed to pinpoint Father Montserrat’s location, given he was at least a Doctor, at a certain distance?
target: Potestne hoc odium adhiberi ut locum Patris Montserrat determinet, cum saltem doctor esset, ad aliquam distantiam?

source: Lumian wasn’t entirely sure, but he intended to experiment with Lugano, a fellow Beyonder of the Earth pathway, to explore the possibilities.
target: Lumian non prorsus certus erat, sed decrevit cum Lugano, congener Beyonder viae Terrae, experimentum facere ad possibilitates explorandas.
